newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka gains slightly on Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka gains slightly on Latvian bourse.

text.p: Shares in leading Latvian bank Unibanka, which earlier announced it is to launch an issue of Global Depository Receipts (GDRs), climbed slightly on the Riga bourse on Thursday although market turnover was stable.
Unibanka is to launch the GDRs via Nomura but has so far not stated how much the issue will be worth or when it will take place.
Its shares rose to 2.07 lats from two lats on the bourse on low trade of 8,977 lats. Overall market turnover was 84,550 lats, not much changed from yesterday's just over 87,000 lats.
Unibanka was outstripped again by its official list partner Riga Transport Fleet, which traded 33,143 lats of shares but dipped to one lat from 1.09 lats.
On the secondary market, the Daugavpils chain manufacturer was again the most traded at 17,298 lats as its shares also dipped to 1.25 lats from 1.30.
The Salacgriva '95 company traded 2,723 lats of shares and rose to 2.74 lats from 2.39 while the Kaija fish cannery dipped further to 1.21 lats from 1.30 lats on turnover of 2,344 lats.
Another active stock was the Lode brick company, which traded 2,475 lats of shares and rose to 99 santimes from 95.
